qualityScrapEffect: Finished stock decreases once. Actual Scrap is additional to Production Scrap.
qualityReworkEffect: Finished stock decreases once; the same quantity becomes reserved WIP for this original item. No Scrap is recorded yet.
qualityReasonHistoryHelp: Rename or archive reasons. Previous rejection records retain their original reason.
qualityReservedHelp: This WIP is reserved for the original Production Item. Warehouse must issue it before processing.
qualityReplacementHelp: Creates an unplanned, linked task for the remaining shortfall. Planning is a separate explicit action.
qualityReversalHelp: Retains the original rejection and records a full reversal. Allowed only when the rejected goods still physically exist and no rework or corrective task has consumed them.
qualityReversalPhysical: The full rejected quantity is still present and identifiable.
sourcePhysicalHelp: Choose the labelled stock actually being moved. Use UNATTRIBUTED for historical or mixed stock. A software selection cannot restore lost physical identification.
sourceIdentifyHelp: Confirm an actual label and counted quantity from this production receipt. This identifies existing stock and does not credit inventory again.
sourceHistoricalHelp: Historical pooled stock remains UNATTRIBUTED. Its production source cannot be guessed.
sourcePhysicalConfirm: I confirm this quantity is physically identifiable by this label.
qualityInvalidQuantity: Enter a positive quantity; pieces must be whole numbers.
qualityUnavailable: This exact source quantity is unavailable. Refresh and verify the physical stock.
qualityReserved: Quality rework is reserved for its original Production Item.
qualityReasonRequired: Choose an active reason and describe Other when selected.
qualityReasonDuplicate: This reusable reason already exists. Choose it from the list.
qualityShortfall: Quantity exceeds the available recovery shortfall, or a corrective task is already pending.
qualityReversalUnavailable: Reversal is unavailable: stock was processed, issued or linked to a corrective task.
sourceIdentity: Verify the physical label and source quantity.
sourceSelectionRequired: Explicit physical source selection is required.
sourceQuantity: Source quantities must exactly equal the quantity being moved.
sourceUnavailable: Selected source stock is unavailable. Refresh and recount.
sourceCommitted: This source stock is reserved for another order.
sourceStockChanged: Stock changed. Refresh and verify the quantities before retrying.
sourceMixedHelp: Available to mark UNATTRIBUTED; stock balance does not change
sourceMixedConfirm: I confirm this stock was mixed or lost its physical identification. Its production source must no longer be claimed.
qualityNetScrapHelp: Actual kg for this filtered production, after reversals; excludes Production Scrap.
tableExportPopup: Allow pop-up windows for this site, then try Print again.
tableExportPrintLimit: Print supports up to 500 matching rows and 2 million text characters. Narrow the filters or export to Excel (up to 10,000 rows).
tableExportExcelLimit: Excel supports up to 10,000 rows, 10 million text characters and 32,767 characters per cell. Narrow the filters or shorten long notes.
tableExportChanged: The matching data changed or could not be read completely. Wait for changes to finish, then retry.
tableExportPrecision: A quantity exceeds Excel’s safe numeric precision. Contact your administrator; no partial file was exported.
qualityRateUnavailable: Scrap rate unavailable: production mass and an applicable threshold are not provided.
qualityReasonChooseMatch: Choose an approved reason or use your text as Other.
qualityReasonInputHelp: Choose a reason or type to search.
maintenancePlanningInactive: Maintenance scheduling is not activated yet.
maintenanceCapacityReserved: This capacity is reserved for maintenance. Review the approved window or actual hold.
maintenanceProductionConflict: This maintenance window conflicts with production.
maintenanceUnknownWindow: A valid execution window cannot be established.
maintenanceConfigurationUnknown: Machine or line configuration is incomplete.
maintenanceConfigurationChanged: Configuration changed. Review the maintenance reservation before starting.
maintenanceTransferUnresolved: An open machine transfer prevents this reservation or assignment.
maintenanceApprovalRequired: Planned maintenance requires a confirmed, valid window.
maintenanceEarlyStart: The maintenance window has not started.
maintenanceLateStart: Insufficient time remains. Reschedule before starting maintenance.
maintenanceMachineNotReady: Prepare the physical machine before starting planned maintenance.
maintenanceUnscheduleRequired: Unschedule future capacity first. Active maintenance holds require verification.
mpQueueHelp: Review maintenance requests and proposed windows alongside production. Proposals do not reserve capacity.
mpActivationBlocked: Maintenance confirmation is not available in this phase. Proposed windows are not bookings.
mpMachineImpact: Independent machine only; linked production still needs validation
mpImpactPending: Scope will be determined by the server when proposing
mpContinuing: Capacity remains held until explicit review or verification
mpPreviewUnavailable: The protected scheduling preview is not implemented. Available gaps and authoritative conflicts cannot be shown here yet. Saving a proposal does not validate production overlaps.
mpGapAdvisory: Timeline gaps are advisory. Resource readiness and conflicts must be validated by the server before booking.
mpHistoryUnavailable: Only the current persisted window is available. The protected schedule revision-history reader is not implemented yet.
mpEndHelp: Leave end blank to use the configured elapsed duration. It is independent of the production working calendar.
mpReaderUnavailable: Scheduling data is unavailable. No reservation or empty-capacity assumption is made.
mpAvailabilityUnknown: Complete maintenance availability is unavailable. Automatic gaps, drag placement and slot suggestions are disabled; manual plans still require normal server validation.
maintenancePlanningIncomplete: The complete scheduling dataset could not be read safely (changed pages or more than 500 records). Refresh; do not assume free capacity.
mpPreviewPermission: Maintenance and Orders view permissions are required for capacity preview.
mpPreviewStale: The request, window or factory scheduling context changed. Refresh and check the window again.
mpNonBinding: Evaluation only; no reservation has been made. Availability is checked again when confirming.
mpReadiness_READY_NOW: Prepared state recorded now; recheck at start
mpNotEligible: This request is not currently eligible for planned scheduling.
mpIncomplete: Occupancy could not be evaluated completely. No usable suggestions are returned.
mpEvidenceMissing: Previous resource evidence was not recorded; current configuration is not substituted.
mpMoreConflicts: Additional conflicts exist; the explanation list is bounded. Availability still evaluates the complete scoped occupancy.
mpNoPreviousSchedule: This is the first recorded schedule; no previous reservation existed.
mpPreviewRequired: Check the current candidate window before confirming or rescheduling.
mpPreviewReady: Preview current. Availability is checked again before a reservation is confirmed.
maintenanceNoEligibleStop: No approved maintenance window is available now.
maintenanceStopRevalidate: The approved machine and window will be checked when you confirm.
maintenanceStopStale: Maintenance changed. Refresh the selection and try again.
maintenanceStopScope: This maintenance approval does not cover this machine.
maintenanceStopWindow: The stop is outside the approved maintenance window.
maintenanceActiveStop: Close the linked physical stop before releasing or changing this maintenance reservation.
maintenanceNoActualStops: No physical stops are linked to this operation.
maintenanceReviewedEvidence: This association change references a previously saved Loss review. The saved review is preserved.
productionReadinessUnavailable: Physical readiness has not been checked. Refresh before starting.
productionQueueChanged: The queue or machine state changed. Refresh and try again.
productionReadinessRechecked: Machine and reservation conditions are checked again when you start.
productionPhysicalNotReady: Production cannot start. Check the affected machine and refresh.
productionReadiness_OPEN_LINKED_STOP: Associated physical stop is still open
productionReadiness_TRANSFER_OWNERSHIP: Required machine is assigned through an open transfer to another item
lossGapMaintenanceApproval: The frozen maintenance approval or machine evidence is incomplete.
lossGapMaintenanceDemand: Recorded production demand or routing is incomplete; zero loss cannot be confirmed.
lossGapMaintenanceConflict: Intended production overlaps the approved maintenance window. Review the conflict before saving.
lossGapMaintenanceOwner: The operating alternative is assigned to a different Production Item.
lossMaintenanceEvidenceChanged: Maintenance or classification evidence changed after review.
lossMaintenanceEvidenceUnknown: This older estimate has insufficient evidence to compare with the current record.
lossMaintenanceHistoryRetained: The recorded estimate is retained unchanged.
mpBoardComplete: Complete operational occupancy for this horizon
mpBoardIncomplete: The board is incomplete. Do not assume missing capacity is free.
mpBoardError: The operational board could not be read. Availability advice is disabled.
mpBoardChanged: The schedule changed while loading. Refresh the board.
mpBoardHorizon: Selected horizon and unscheduled operational requests
mpBoardOutside: This placement is outside the loaded horizon. Adjust the visible dates before checking availability.
mpManualServerValidation: Availability is not established for this placement. Saving requests authoritative server validation.
prv3Retained: You have an unconfirmed submission. Check its status before recording it again.
prv3NoPermission: You can view production, but your current permissions do not allow recording.
prv3StorageUnavailable: Recovery storage is unavailable. Nothing new was sent. Restore browser storage, then try again.
prv3InvalidQuantity: Enter a valid, non-negative decimal quantity.
prv3Unresolved: Resolve your retained submission before starting a different recording.
prv3Expired: This shift has ended. A new entry cannot be assigned to it. Keep your measurements and contact an authorized engineer.
prv3UnknownHelp: It may already be saved. Check its status or retry this same submission; do not enter the measurement again.
prv3SavedHelp: Confirmed by the recording service. Original measurements remain available in History.
prv3CurrentValues: Current official quantities after any corrections
prv3SameIntent: The same submission is retained across refresh and retries.
prv3EndIntro: Review the actual quantities before ending execution. Edit the suggestion to match what was produced.
prv3SummaryUnavailable: Production totals could not be verified. Refresh and try again; your draft is kept.
prv3EndWithoutConfirm: End execution without adding production? Recorded quantities will stay unchanged, and any remaining shortage will stay outstanding.
prv3FinishPending: Execution completion could not be confirmed. Check or retry ending execution; do not record the same output again.
prv3SavedEndPending: Production is saved. Execution completion is still pending. Retry ending execution without recording the output again.
prv3SavedAndEnded: Production is saved and execution has ended. Any remaining quantity stays outstanding.
prv3NoRecordingAdded: No new production was recorded. Existing quantities and outstanding shortages are unchanged.
prv3Search: Find a Product, order or line
prv3WorkChanged: The work list changed. Refresh it and review your selection; your measurements are retained.
prv3WorkUnavailable: This production work is not available for recording. Refresh and review its current status.
prv3NoWork: No eligible work in this shift. Planned or never-started work does not appear here.
prv3OccurrenceUnavailable: A verified current-shift period is not available yet. Existing active or WIP recording remains under Other recording options.
prv3LateDisabled: This job is completed. Recording additional output is not enabled by the server. Its completed status is unchanged.
prv3Declare: These quantities were produced in this shift only, not in earlier shifts.
prv3Declaration: Confirm that these quantities belong only to the displayed shift.
prv3EmptyQuantity: Enter Good, Scrap or unfinished output before saving.
prv3WipRequired: Enter the unfinished quantity and explain the work still needed.
prv3ZeroScrap: Enter 0 when there is no Scrap.
prv3RecentUnavailable: Recent entries could not be loaded. Do not assume that an earlier entry was not saved.
prv3RefreshAfterSave: Your save is confirmed, but refreshed details are unavailable. Try loading History later.
prv3Similar: A recent entry has the same work and quantities. Check it before saving another measurement. This warning does not block a separate legitimate entry.
prv3OtherHelp: Use the existing workflow for WIP processing, independent machines, startup Scrap or an authorized manual shift.
prv3ExistingHelp: Required source, destination, quantities and remaining work stay visible in the existing protected workflow. WIP processing does not inherit a completed job’s production period.
recordingUnavailable: Recording is not available for this work.
recordingValidation: Check the quantities and required information, then try again.
recordingContextChanged: This work or shift has changed. Review the current information before saving.
prv3InvalidGood: Enter a valid Good quantity in the displayed unit.
prv3InvalidScrap: Enter a valid Scrap quantity in KG.
prv3InvalidStartupScrap: Startup Scrap must be between zero and Total Scrap.
prv3StartupSelect: Choose the recorded startup for this scrap.
prv3StartupUnavailable: The recorded startup is unavailable for this work and shift.
prv3StartupTimeHelp: Enter when this startup took place on the selected line. It is saved with this production entry.
prv3StartupTimeInvalid: Enter a past startup time within a verified run on this line in the current shift.
prv3StartupQuestion: Did this production run include a startup?
prv3StartupChooseDate: Choose the date when this startup occurred.
prv3StartupAlreadyRecorded: A startup is already recorded in this minute. Choose it from the list.
prv3ScrapFormula: Regular Scrap = Total Scrap − Startup Scrap
unauthorized: Sign in again to check this submission. Its original measurements are still retained.
historyPreferenceUnavailable: Column changes apply here, but could not be saved in this browser.
historyOrderScrap: Total Scrap · this product and order
historyOrderScrapUnavailable: The complete official Scrap total is unavailable.
historyPeriodDate: Dates covered by the recorded production period
historyAttributionMissing: Production date is not recorded. Submission time is available in Columns.
historyColumnScope: Column choices apply to this table. Exports keep the existing report columns.
historySelectRecord: Select a record to view details or use Actions.
pcPendingSuccess: Pending approval — official quantities are unchanged.
pcRejectedSuccess: Correction rejected — official quantities are unchanged.
pcPendingHelp: Your request does not change official quantities until approved.
pcSelfApprovalHelp: Your approval permission applies this correction when saved. Scrap review remains separate.
pcStorageError: This browser cannot safely retain the retry details. Submission is blocked.
pcStale: The record changed. Reload the latest values before submitting a new correction.
pcUncertain: The outcome is not confirmed. Check status or retry the same request; do not create another correction.
pcQueueHelp: Review requested corrections. Only approved changes affect official production.
pcMyRequestsHelp: Only your submissions are shown. Load more to include further requests.
qvIntro: Select production stock to inspect its history or record a rejection.
qvNoStock: No stock is currently available for rejection.
qvCaption: Select one stock receipt. Production quantity is the shift total; rejection applies only to the selected stock.
qvExceeds: The rejected quantity exceeds the quantity available for rejection. Please check the amount.
wvTableHelp: Select an item for Actions. Double-click to view details.
wvQuantityHelp: Available is the recorded unreserved balance. Use the existing item and source rules for each issue or sale.
wvSourceHelp: Labels identify separately counted stock. UNATTRIBUTED is historical or mixed stock without a proven production source. Selecting a label never creates physical traceability.
warehouseDispatchEmpty: No orders in the dispatch queue.
planningQueueHelp: Open a work reference to schedule it, or drag eligible work onto the timeline.
planningExceptionalHelp: Use these protected decisions when production leaves unfinished material or outstanding demand. Created work joins the same scheduling queue above.
prv3CompletedSameShift: Execution is complete. You can record its production until this shift ends.
whProjectionHelp: The forecast includes eligible incoming production and outstanding demand. It is separate from physical stock.
planningTimezoneMissing: Factory timezone is missing. Configure it before scheduling.
prv3ShiftGap: No shift covers the current time. Ask your planner to check the shift schedule, then refresh.
prv3ExactUnavailable: This work is not available for recording in the current shift. Refresh or ask your planner to check its execution and shift.
whMovementDescription: Read-only stock entries, exits and reservation history
whSettingsDescription: Add materials, configure supply and stock limits, or record authorized adjustments
whForecastHelp: Projected Stock uses Available + Expected Incoming + active production remaining − committed and uncovered Sales demand. Incoming includes eligible production and purchasing; received output is already in On Hand.
whMaterialForecastHelp: Projected Stock uses Available + eligible expected purchasing receipts.
whShortageHelp: Expected Shortage is unmet forecast demand, not negative physical stock.
planningAvailabilityChanged: Availability changed. Refresh the preview before placing this job.
historicalPending: Pending Production Engineer Approval. No official production or stock has been added.
prv3MakeupCommitted: Linked make-up work is already allocated. Record its output on the linked job.
compPlanningConflict: Compensation would overlap another scheduled commitment. Review the referenced schedule with Planning, or submit a smaller quantity only if it fits.
compActiveContext: The execution or current shift is not eligible. Check execution and shift readiness.
compShiftCapacity: The proposed compensation does not fit the current shift. Review the remaining work with Planning.
compNotReady: Required machines or maintenance are not ready. Resolve the blocker before continuing.
compCapacityUnknown: A reliable production rate is unavailable. Check the configured capabilities.
compActiveRequired: The original execution is still active. Use compensation on that execution; resolve any real scheduling conflict first.
compAddedActive: Compensation added to the current execution. Original demand is unchanged; new output still requires Quality and Warehouse receipt.
compWorkCreated: Linked work created for Planning. Inspection and Warehouse receipt remain required.
planningMaintenanceConflict: Scheduled maintenance occupies this interval. Choose another available time.
planningOrderConflict: This interval is occupied by Production Order
ffAnimationOnly: Diagram animations only. Live data continues updating.
ffDelayedWorkHelp: Machines assigned to active work past its planned finish. This does not mean the machine is stopped.
ffAffectedHelp: Effective flow is affected by another machine or resource. This is separate from schedule delay.
historicalApprovedSaved: Production recorded and approved; sent to Quality.
historicalExcessConfirmation: The entered quantity exceeds the remaining amount. Confirm the additional production before continuing.
historicalExistingPending: This shift and job already have a pending submission. Review the existing request; do not submit it again.
historicalUnconfirmed: The save could not be confirmed. Check its status or retry the same submission. Your entries are preserved.
historicalOwnPending: Submitted by you under the earlier policy. Another authorized approver must review it. It will not be duplicated or approved automatically.
planningPreparationReview: Material preparation is recorded. Production and Warehouse must review the impact. This confirmation does not move or return material.
planningWarningImpact: This change is close to the scheduled start or overdue. Review the impact on Production and Warehouse.
planningExceptionAck: I have reviewed the schedule and preparation impact.
planning_confirmation_required: Review and confirm the exceptional change and enter its reason.
planning_policy_invalid: Enter positive hours, up to 8760, using at most six decimal places.
planning_changed: The plan or preparation changed. Reopen the change and review the latest state.
planning_material_custody: Issued material remains assigned to this job. Moving to another line or unscheduling requires protected Warehouse custody resolution first.
planningAllocatedMaterial: Unfinished material is allocated to this work. Warehouse preparation needs review.
planning_material_consumed: Material has already been consumed. Review the production work before changing its schedule.
materialRouteHelp: Choose the materials physically consumed by this stage. Compound stock and its raw ingredients are never requested together.
materialMode_DIRECT_RAW: Make product directly from raw ingredients
materialMode_COMPOUND_MANUFACTURE: Make compound from its recipe ingredients
materialCustodyHelp: Reservation keeps material in Warehouse. Handover moves it to Production custody; it does not record consumption.
materialMeasuredHelp: Enter the actual measured material used. This does not deduct Warehouse stock again or create production output.
materialPhysicalHandover: I confirm this quantity was physically handed to this Production Order.
materialPhysicalReturn: I confirm this unused quantity was physically returned to Warehouse.
materialNoRequests: No material requests for this work.
material_invalid: Check the quantity and selected request.
material_configuration_invalid: Check the product, physical-input route, recipe and stock unit in Products.
material_changed: The material request changed. Refresh and review the latest quantities.
material_quantity: Enter a positive amount no greater than the currently eligible quantity.
material_shortage: Not enough available stock. Reserve a smaller quantity or wait for receipt.
material_custody_review: This earlier issue needs a custody review before using the new material actions.
material_preparation_unavailable: Preparation is postponed or its configuration needs review. Check the plan and Product input settings.
material_requirement_review: The recipe, route or requests changed. Review existing material commitments before preparing more.
material_route_missing: Set the physical production inputs for this product in Products before automatic preparation.
material_route_ambiguous: More than one configured input stage matches this line. Review the product route.
material_weight_missing: Set a valid product weight per stock unit in Products.
material_recipe_missing: Add a valid compound recipe in Products.
material_unit_missing: Match recipe ingredient units to the material stock units.
planning_material_return_required: Release unissued reservations and physically return unused issued materials before changing the line.
materialState_AWAITING_RESERVATION: Postponed — reserve again when preparation resumes
materialEvent_RELEASED: Preparation postponed — unissued reservation released; request remains open
salesUnitInvalid: Select a supported unit and enter a valid quantity and pipe length.
salesUnitMissing: This product needs a stock unit configured before it can be sold.
pipe_count_invalid: Enter a whole number of pipes / pieces.
pipe_length_invalid: Enter a pipe length from 0.000001 to 1000 meters, with at most 6 decimal places.
pipe_product_invalid: This product is not configured for cut-length sales.
pipe_identity_immutable: An existing pipe specification cannot be changed.
materialAmountWithinEligible: Enter a positive quantity within the eligible amount shown.
material_reserve_first: Reserve this material first, then confirm its physical handover.
material_no_pending: The full requirement is already reserved or handed over.
material_nothing_eligible: There is no quantity eligible for this action.
material_request_closed: This request is cancelled or rejected. It cannot be reopened here.
material_order_reconciliation: Production is finished. Missing handover or unused custody requires a separate review; historical delivery is not assumed.
material_order_closed: Production is finished; no new handover is allowed.
material_plan_required: Schedule this work before preparing its materials.
material_outside_window: Deferred because this work is outside the preparation window. Review the plan; re-entry reuses this request.
material_recheck_required: This request was deferred under an earlier plan. Recheck it before reserving or handing over material.
material_handover_required: Required materials have not been physically handed over from Warehouse.
productionMaterialNotReady: Production cannot start. Required materials have not been handed over from Warehouse.
rawReturnHelp: Request the return of unused material from Production. Warehouse confirms the actual receipt separately.
rawReturnCreated: Return requested; no stock has moved.
rawReturnNone: No unused material is currently available for a new return request.
rawReturnPhysical: I confirm this quantity was physically received in the destination Warehouse.
rawReturnReceiptHelp: Receipt transfers unused custody to Warehouse. It does not create material or change the original production output.
material_return_scope: Select a valid raw material, Production location and active Raw Materials Warehouse.
material_return_unavailable: The unused balance changed or is already reserved for another return. Refresh and check the available quantity.
material_return_closed: This return is already received or cancelled. Refresh its current status.
material_return_reason: Explain why the unreceived remainder is being cancelled.
material_use_return_request: Use a separate Raw Material Return request. The original issuance remains completed.
material_reconciliation_reason: Enter the reason and measurement context for this Warehouse reconciliation.
material_deviation_reason: Explain the extra quantity before reserving or issuing above the recipe warning threshold.
materialWarehouseOwnership: Warehouse records and reconciles material quantities. Production records output, Scrap and unfinished work.
materialReconciliationHelp: Enter the corrected cumulative accounted consumption, based on Warehouse measurements. Explain the adjustment. This does not deduct Warehouse stock again.
materialIssueDeviation: Recipe remainder: {expected} {unit}. This extra quantity exceeds the configured warning threshold. Explain the difference.
materialPartialIssue: Partial quantity. Recipe remainder before this action: {expected} {unit}; still outstanding after it: {remaining}.
materialDeviationPolicyHelp: Warn when an issued quantity differs from the recipe remainder beyond this percentage. Zero warns on every difference. Extra quantities remain subject to stock, reservation and explanation checks.
material_use_preparation_workflow: Issue raw materials through the material request for the correct Production Order. Legacy issue cannot record consumption automatically.
machineStopImpactValidated: Answer for the equipment’s role. Actual production loss is calculated from the stop and intended work.
machine_impact_conflict: The selected impact conflicts with the machine role or assigned process. Review the machine configuration.
execution_no_active_work: Start a Production Order before running this machine.
execution_line_idle: This line has no active work to pause or resume.
execution_machine_stopped: A required machine is stopped or unavailable. Resolve the stop before starting.
productionReadiness_MACHINE_STOPPED: A required machine is stopped or unavailable.
psCustodyHelp: Delivered materials remain physical Production Stock until output is recorded or unused stock is returned. Reservations do not consume material.
psPhysicalDelivery: I confirm these quantities were physically delivered to Production Stock.
psDeliveryHelp: Confirm only the materials physically delivered. Partial delivery is allowed; consumption is recorded later from actual production.
psLegacyHelp: Historical per-order custody remains separate and needs evidence-based reconciliation before reuse.
psAdjustmentConfirm: I confirm the physical count and the documented adjustment reason.
psRequestHelp: Request the materials needed for Production Stock, usually for this shift. A request may contain several materials and is independent of Production Orders.
psHandoverHelp: Count all raw materials physically received from the outgoing shift. Expected stock includes reserved and unreserved material. Differences are recorded for investigation; this does not adjust accounting stock.
psRefreshCount: Refresh expected stock and restart count
production_stock_disabled: Production Stock is not activated for this factory. Historical custody must be reviewed before the local cutover.
production_stock_legacy_review: Historical material custody needs reconciliation before this order can use shared Production Stock.
production_stock_shortage: Insufficient unreserved Production Stock. Review the exact material shortages.
production_stock_count_required: Count every listed material, including zero quantities.
production_stock_count_changed: Stock changed during counting. Refresh expected stock and recount before confirming.
production_stock_investigation_required: Add investigation or resolution notes for the significant difference.
production_stock_recipe_review: A valid raw-material recipe is required before automatic consumption.
production_stock_schedule_required: Plan the order on a line and within the current shift before reserving material.
production_stock_existing_source: Existing manufactured-source work follows its original material contract.
psUncertain: A previous stock command has an unconfirmed outcome. Recover that exact command before making another change.
production_stock_no_shift_output: No output is scheduled in the remaining current shift. Review the schedule or reserve in its scheduled shift.
psStartBlocked: Production cannot start. Review this shift’s stock and schedule.
psLegacyOrderHelp: This order has separate legacy custody. Shared Production Stock cannot replace or consume it automatically. Verify an unused-material return or reconcile the recorded custody before Start.
f34PauseHelp: Record all actual output and Scrap before pausing. This releases actual line capacity and unused shift reservations. The approved line and Gantt times, quantities, physical stock, Quality and material history stay unchanged. This does not finish the order.
f34UnscheduleHelp: Return this unstarted order to the unscheduled queue. Keep the order, material custody and history.
f34DispatchHelp: Start or resume the selected order now on its approved line. The Gantt plan stays unchanged. Current-shift materials, permissions, capabilities, machines, Maintenance and Quality are checked before starting.
f34OutputConfirmed: All actual output and Scrap for this run have been recorded.
f34ScheduleWarning: I understand that removing this assignment changes the plan. Review any issued materials with Warehouse; unscheduling does not return or reconcile them.
f34RetryHelp: The result is not confirmed. Retry the same action to recover its result before changing the request.
execution_context_changed: The order changed. Review its latest state and try again.
execution_command_conflict: This action has a different saved request. Review the latest order before retrying.
execution_record_output_first: Record all actual output and Scrap, then confirm before releasing the line.
execution_end_transfer_first: End the active machine transfer using its existing workflow before releasing this order.
execution_not_active: This order is no longer active. Refresh the line.
execution_no_remaining: No ordinary work remains. Review production and Quality before finishing or authorizing additional work.
execution_plan_required: Schedule this order on a compatible line before starting.
execution_line_busy: Another order is active on this line. Pause and release it, or finish it, before starting another.
execution_out_of_sequence: Choose this order explicitly to change the execution sequence.
f34ScheduleToContinue: The line is released. Schedule the remaining work in Planning, then resume it here.
f341NoScheduledOrders: No scheduled orders on this line
f341ReleaseCurrentFirst: This line is running another order. Pause & Release that order, or finish it, before starting this selection.
f341PlanUnchanged: Floor actions change actual execution only. Change the approved schedule in Planning.
execution_orders_changed: The scheduled-order list changed or could not be loaded completely. Refresh before starting.
execution_orders_invalid: The scheduled-order list could not be read. Refresh and try again.
execution_plan_immutable: Execution cannot change the approved plan. Use Planning to change the schedule.
execution_order_interrupted: This order is paused. Its unused reservations are released; Resume checks current-shift materials again.
executionPaused: Order paused; actual line capacity released.
executionRefreshAfterSuccess: The action is confirmed. The latest screen details could not be loaded; refresh to see current status. Do not repeat the action.
executionOutcomeUnknown: The action’s result is not confirmed. Check its status before retrying the same action.
executionRejected: The action was not applied. Refresh the order and review its readiness before trying again.
executionPendingStorage: The pending action could not be safely saved or read. Restore browser storage access before submitting.
executionPendingConflict: A different action is still pending for this order. Check its outcome first.
executionTimelineHelp: Select a time bar, then review the order below. Selection does not change the plan.
executionNoUnfinished: No unfinished orders are scheduled on this line.
executionChecksAtStart: Materials and current conditions are checked before Start.
executionPriorityReason: Starting this order ahead of earlier work requires a reason.
executionSelectionOnly: Selecting an order does not start it or change the plan.
executionChooseCard: Choose an order card to review on the Floor.
psReservationHistoryHelp: These are retained forecast projections, not a transaction log. Zero means no current booking; earlier booked amounts may no longer be retained. Line labels show current assignments.
psReservationExplanation: Available = physical stock − order reservations − pending returns. An order’s own valid booking counts toward its readiness; other orders’ bookings are unavailable. Start rechecks the current shift, BOM and all safety checks.
psMaterialsReady: Current booking covers its forecast; Start rechecks.
psNoCurrentBooking: No current shift booking. Start checks the remaining work and available materials.
transferStopRequired: An open downtime record is required. Refresh and review this machine's stop.
transferNoCompatibleAvailable: No compatible configured alternative is available. Check its product capability, current assignment and open transfers.
machineUnavailable: Unavailable — review physical status and downtime
machineFlowBlocked: Production flow is blocked. Review the stopped equipment or compatible alternatives.
transferReturnRequiresStop: Stop the active replacement using Stop Machine before returning production. Record its physical handover reason, then return to the original machine. Refresh if its status has changed.
f20TransferHelp: Continue the same order on a compatible line. The approved Planning schedule stays unchanged. Availability and materials are checked again when you transfer.
f20NoEligibleOrder: No unfinished assigned order is available for this source line.
f20NoConfiguredAlternative: No alternative machine is configured. Ask an authorized engineer to review Machine Details & Settings.
f20Transferred: Production transfer confirmed. The same order is running on its alternative line; Planning is unchanged.
f20SourceChanged: The source execution line changed. Refresh and select the current order and machine.
f20DestinationLineRequired: Choose a machine on another production line. Same-line or independent equipment uses the existing machine-replacement action.
f20DestinationBusy: The destination line or its equipment already has active work or an assignment. Release it safely before transferring.
f20DestinationPaused: The destination line is paused. Review its pause and equipment before transferring.
f20FixedRoute: Another required process machine is outside the destination route. Review the complete product routing; a single alternative cannot replace the whole process.
f20DependencyMismatch: The alternative's configured production impact does not satisfy the required machine's role. An authorized engineer must review its dependencies.
f20SharedStockRequired: Cross-line execution requires the protected shared Production Stock workflow and verified material custody.
f20SourceWorkRequired: This work uses an existing WIP/source lot or staged compound. Its physical source workflow must be reviewed before cross-line execution.
f20ReplaceEquipmentOnly: Replace machine on the current route
f20DestinationUnavailable: The alternative is not physically idle and available. Review its status and open downtime.
f45WeightHelp: The stock-unit weight is calculated from the stated measurement. A piece measured in meters uses piece weight ÷ piece length. No stock quantity is changed.
f45WeightHistoryHelp: Existing weight is retained because this product has production or inventory history. Changing its weight needs a separate reviewed action.
f45SaveReusable: Also save as a reusable recipe
f45DraftHelp: This product can be saved incomplete. Production stays blocked until its recipe, weight, material source and eligible equipment are configured.
f45SharedHelp: Selecting a saved recipe does not edit it. To change ingredients only for this product, choose Define a recipe here.
f45InputDefault: Keep existing; new recipes use raw materials
f45StageRoutes: Existing stage-specific material sources stay unchanged and may add production requirements.
f45LinesHelp: Choose each line and the machines that can produce this product. Rates use the production unit per hour. Setup times and capabilities for other products are preserved. Production still checks routing, stops, materials and permissions.
f45LinePermission: Changing line eligibility requires machine-configuration permission. Existing capabilities will be retained.
f45ChooseMachine: Select at least one compatible production machine for this line.
f45RatesAlign: Saving line changes aligns selected machines to the displayed line rate and production unit.
f45SaveUnknown: The save result is not confirmed. Check its status or retry the exact same save before making other changes.
f45SavedRefresh: Product saved. Refresh the page to show its latest configuration.
f45Invalid: Review the product fields, recipe quantities and line selections. Nothing was saved.
f45Changed: This configuration changed while you were editing. Reload it before saving.
f45Weight: Enter a positive weight with a valid stock unit and measurement basis.
f45Length: Enter the positive length in meters of the piece you weighed.
f45Inherited: Cut-length products inherit recipe and equipment from their base product. Edit the base product for those settings.
f45InheritedHelp: Recipe and equipment are inherited from the base product; existing cut-length identity is retained.
f45HistoricalWeight: This weight has production or stock history and cannot be rewritten here. Keep it unchanged.
f45ActiveDefinition: Active or partially produced work uses this definition. Finish or safely interrupt and review that work before changing its recipe or units.
f45RecipeKeep: Keep the current recipe or explicitly create a new version. Removing an existing recipe is not part of saving an incomplete product.
f45SharedRecipe: Other products use this recipe. Keep it unchanged here; create a product-specific recipe on the consuming product to avoid changing shared ingredients.
f45CodeUsed: This product code is already used. Enter another code or leave it blank for automatic generation.
f45Line: Each enabled line needs a positive rate, a supported unit and at least one machine belonging to that line.
f45RecipeInvalid: Choose raw materials once each and enter positive kg quantities. Use a valid saved recipe or review the recipe definition.
f45ActiveCapability: This machine is participating in active production. Keep its existing capability and rate; adding other eligible lines is still allowed.
f45UnitIdentity: This product has a saved recipe or shared identity. Keep its product type and stock unit unchanged.
f45RecipeBasis: Raw material quantities below are kg needed for 1 kg of product weight. Retained waste allowances are used for forecasts only.
f45BatchBasis: Ingredient quantities are for {kg} kg of recipe output. Waste allowances are for forecasts only.
f45RawSource: This product currently uses premixed compound stock. To use a product-only raw recipe, explicitly select Raw Materials under Physical production inputs.
f46PlanUnknown: Active production has no valid planned finish. Review its plan; future scheduling remains available.
f46ReasonPending: Delay reason pending · grace period: {minutes} min
f46Recorded: Delay details recorded. Approved plan unchanged.
f46Nonblocking: Record the operational reason. Production recording and future scheduling remain available while a reason is pending.
f46GraceMinutes: Delay reason grace period (minutes) · factory setting
f46GraceHelp: Default: 15 minutes after approved planned finish. Delay appears immediately; a missing reason never stops production or blocks recording or Planning.
f46ReadUnavailable: Delay details could not be refreshed. Other operations remain available; refresh to check the latest details.
f46OutcomeUnknown: Save outcome is not yet confirmed. Check its status or retry the same save.
f46Invalid: Review the delay details or grace period. Nothing was saved.
f46Changed: Production or delay details changed. Refresh the form before saving.
f46ReasonRequired: Enter a delay reason between 3 and 500 characters.
f46NotDelayed: This order is no longer active and overdue. Refresh its current status.
f46EstimateFuture: Enter a future estimated completion time, or leave it blank.
f46HistoryImmutable: Recorded delay history cannot be rewritten. Add a new reason or estimate instead.
f46PotentialDelay: Actual production is behind schedule; the approved plan is unchanged. Review possible execution impact.
f48PhysicalConfirmed: I confirm the original equipment has recovered and been checked, all output/Scrap is recorded, and physical handover is safe.
f48MachineHelp: Return the borrowed machine assignment to the original equipment. The order stays on its actual line and the approved plan is unchanged. Healthy replacement equipment becomes Idle without a downtime record.
f48LineHelp: Return this same order to its original actual line. Record all output before handover. Approved Planning, quantities and stock are preserved.
f48Returned: Production returned to the original machine. Approved plan unchanged.
f48UseReturn: Use Return Production to Original Machine to confirm recovery and safe handover. No manual stop of healthy replacement equipment is needed.
f48ConfirmHandover: Confirm equipment recovery, recorded output and safe physical handover before returning production.
f48TransferChanged: This transfer or equipment state changed. Refresh and review the return again.
f48RecoveryRequired: Recover the original machine first. Offline or setup equipment cannot receive production.
f48RecoveryChanged: The original machine has a different unresolved stop. Review that stop before returning production.
f48LineUnavailable: The original line is paused, archived or unavailable. Resolve its availability before returning production.
f48DependencyStopped: Another required machine on the original route is unavailable. Recover that machine before returning production.
f48AlternativeStopConflict: The replacement is marked Running but has open downtime. Review that machine state before handover; its downtime will not be closed by this return.
